title: French Country Lentil Stew
description: A hearty, comforting stew made with lentils and quintessential French flavors, perfect for a chilly evening.
instructions: Heat the skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced onion and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the sliced carrot and celery and cook for an additional 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the tomato paste and cook for 1 minute.
Add the red wine and cook until reduced by half, about 5 minutes.
Add the vegetable broth, lentils, thyme, and bay leaves.
Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 30-40 minutes, or until the lentils are tender.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh thyme if desired.
